landing.faq.stack.question: What is CADCraft?
landing.faq.stack.answer: CADCraft is a free, open-source, AutoCAD-style CAD application written in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team. It runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD and in the browser.
landing.faq.payment.question: Is CADCraft free?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Yes. CADCraft is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0. There is no license fee, subscription or account.
landing.faq.database.question: Which file formats does CADCraft support?
landing.faq.database.answer: The desktop app opens DWG R13 to 2018 and DXF R12 to 2018, saves DXF and DWG in versions 2000 to 2018, and exports PDF, SVG and PNG. The online version reads DXF only.
landing.faq.customize.question: How is CADCraft different from AutoCAD?
landing.faq.customize.answer: CADCraft is free, open source and built to be controlled by AI agents. AutoCAD is the mature industry standard with full DWG fidelity, 3D modeling and vendor support. See our comparison page for details.
landing.faq.license.question: Who runs cadcraft.org?
landing.faq.license.answer: CADCraft AI is an independent guide and is not affiliated with Autodesk or the ArtCraft team. Questions or corrections: support@cadcraft.org.

hotel.how.title: How to Make a Hotel Lobby AI Video
hotel.how.one.title: Pick two clear portraits
hotel.how.one.text: Choose one clear photo for each performer. A visible face, natural expression and similar camera angle give the video model a stronger reference for keeping two people distinct.
hotel.how.two.title: Set the timing
hotel.how.two.text: Write a simple sequence: person A begins, person B reacts, then the lead changes. A fixed camera and small gestures usually make the first attempt easier to judge.
hotel.how.three.title: Generate and review
hotel.how.three.text: Press generate, choose a plan, and we compose both people in the orange booth before transferring the Hotel Lobby performance and audio onto them. Review identity, hands, the center microphone and left-right placement before you share.
hotel.ideas.title: Hotel Lobby AI Ideas for Friends, Siblings and Couples
hotel.ideas.description: The duet works best when the relationship between the two performers is easy to understand. Start with one moment, one camera angle and a clear handoff.
hotel.ideas.friends.title: Friends on the mic
hotel.ideas.friends.text: Make a call and response: one friend takes the first line, the other answers at the mic. Use eye contact, smiles and small gestures to show their connection.
hotel.ideas.siblings.title: Sibling back and forth
hotel.ideas.siblings.text: One sibling starts confidently; the other joins on the next beat. Keep them on opposite sides of the orange booth and let their expressions tell the story.
hotel.ideas.couples.title: Couples in sync
hotel.ideas.couples.text: Give a couple a quiet first verse and a shared chorus. Keep the gestures small and let a glance across the microphone mark the moment they come together.
hotel.bottom.title: The mic is waiting.
hotel.bottom.text: Choose your two performers and make the lobby scene your own.
hotel.footer.line: Create a two-person AI duet video with Hotel Lobby AI.

hotel.explainer.title: What is the Hotel Lobby AI filter?
hotel.explainer.origin: The trend comes from a real performance. On June 17, 2022, the COLORS YouTube channel released Quavo and Takeoff performing their song "Hotel Lobby" against a flat orange backdrop, trading lines on a single microphone hung from the ceiling. In September 2026 creators on TikTok and X began using AI video tools to swap the two rappers for friends, couples, celebrities, fictional characters and even pets while keeping the original moves, lip-sync and audio — and the "Hotel Lobby AI" meme took off.
hotel.explainer.one: Two subjects stand on opposite sides of one hanging microphone while the camera holds steady. One leads, the other reacts, and then they trade the moment. Friends, partners or family members can appear together even when their source photos were taken separately.
hotel.explainer.two: This page makes that look for you. Choose two portraits, decide who appears on each side and optionally add a styling note. We compose the scene with GPT Image 2 and animate it with DreamActor motion transfer, which carries over the reference performance and its audio.
hotel.explainer.three: Think of it as a short scene. A good result keeps each person recognizable, gives both people room and places the microphone between them. Orange walls, warm light and a steady camera unify the setup. Results vary with the model and photos, so review the clip before posting.
hotel.guide.title: Make your Hotel Lobby AI duet look more like your people
hotel.guide.intro: A precise prompt helps, but the photos you choose set the ceiling for the final scene. These checks can reduce common identity and composition problems before you generate.
hotel.guide.photos.title: Start with useful portraits
hotel.guide.photos.text: Use sharp images with full faces and enough clothing to guide the scene. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, crowded backgrounds and cropped faces. Similar lighting and perspective can make the duet feel more consistent. If one portrait is a close-up and the other shows a full body, crop or replace one so the references match more closely. Neutral expressions leave more room for a believable reaction. Only transform images you have permission to use.
hotel.guide.motion.title: Keep the action readable
hotel.guide.motion.text: Describe one short exchange: a lead singer, a listening reaction and a handoff. Ask for natural mouth movement and small gestures while the camera stays centered. State whose lips move in each beat so the performers do not appear to sing the same line at once. Fast turns and sudden cuts can make faces or left-right positions harder to preserve.
hotel.guide.review.title: Inspect the first take
hotel.guide.review.text: Watch the clip before sharing. Confirm that A stays left, B stays right and the microphone stays between them. Check for warped hands, merged faces, extra people or changing outfits. Watch once with the sound off: the handoff should still make visual sense. If a face changes midway, shorten the scene before adding more movement. If the scene breaks, simplify your direction and try again.
hotel.prompt.title: Hotel Lobby AI Prompt (Copy and Paste)
hotel.prompt.one: For a Hotel Lobby AI duet, the starter prompt names the main visual anchors: a vertical 9:16 frame, a matte-orange booth, two separate people, one black microphone, soft light and a locked camera. It also asks the model to preserve faces and outfits and avoid side swaps, added people, captions and watermarks. These constraints give the generator a clearer shot list than a vague request to make two photos sing together.
hotel.prompt.two: Use the direction field for one styling detail, such as outfits, accessories or expressions. Keep it short so the core composition still leads — the booth, the center microphone and left-right placement are fixed by the base prompt. If the first result is off, change one thing at a time and generate again.
hotel.prompt.copy_text: Two people from my two reference photos perform a duet in a seamless burnt-orange recording booth. Person A (photo 1) stands on the left, Person B (photo 2) on the right, facing each other across one black microphone hanging at face level in the exact center. Vertical 9:16, static centered camera, soft even studio light, framed from the knees up. A sings the first line while B listens and nods; B takes the next line while A reacts; then they share the mic. Natural lip-sync and small hand gestures. Keep each face, hairstyle and outfit unchanged. No side swaps, no extra people, no captions, no watermark.
hotel.faq.title: Hotel Lobby AI FAQ
hotel.faq.one.question: Can I generate the duet video on this page?
hotel.faq.one.answer: Yes. Sign in, upload one photo for each side and press Generate. The scene is ready in under a minute and the finished video in about 3–5 minutes. Each video uses credits.
hotel.faq.two.question: What happens to my photos?
hotel.faq.two.answer: When you press Generate, your two photos are resized in your browser and sent to our AI provider (fal.ai) to create the scene and the video. They are not uploaded before you press Generate. Only use photos you have permission to use.
hotel.faq.three.question: Can I make the duet with two separate photos?
hotel.faq.three.answer: Yes. Use one clear reference for each person, with A on the left and B on the right. Identity preservation depends on the generator and photos, so inspect the result.
hotel.faq.four.question: Why do the faces or positions change in my result?
hotel.faq.four.answer: Models can drift when references are unclear or actions are busy. Use visible faces, remove camera moves and describe a shorter exchange. Repeat left-right placement and request one continuous shot. A usable clip may take several tries.
hotel.faq.five.question: Can I use photos of a couple or friends?
hotel.faq.five.answer: Yes. The orange booth can frame a couple, friends or family — including a parent and their child, as long as you're that child's parent or legal guardian. Change the performance direction but keep identities separate. Get permission from everyone pictured and identify the result as AI-generated when you share it.
hotel.faq.six.question: How much does a Hotel Lobby AI video cost?
hotel.faq.six.answer: Every generation uses credits, and the exact amount is shown on the button and in the pricing section. Choose a one-time pack or subscribe monthly. If a generation fails, the credits go back to your balance automatically.
hotel.faq.seven.question: What is the hotel lobby AI trend?
hotel.faq.seven.answer: It is a two-person duet scene in an orange recording booth. One person starts a line beside a hanging microphone, and the other responds. Creators often use two separate photos to plan a shared AI video scene.
hotel.faq.eight.question: Is the video generated on this site?
hotel.faq.eight.answer: Yes. The scene preview and the finished video are both generated here on Hotel Lobby AI — you don't need any other app or account. Finished videos are saved in My videos.

cad.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
cad.faq.a1: Yes. CADCraft is open source under MIT OR Apache-2.0 and free to use on the desktop and in the browser, with no license fee and no account required to draw. Pro cloud features on this site are optional ($4.9/month or $29/year).
cad.faq.a2: No. CADCraft is an independent, clean-room project by the ArtCraft team that recreates the AutoCAD-style workflow. It is not affiliated with Autodesk. AutoCAD is a trademark of Autodesk, Inc.
cad.faq.a3: Yes, in the desktop app. It opens DWG R13 through 2018 and reads DXF R12 through 2018 (ASCII and binary). It saves DXF and DWG in any version from 2000 to 2018 (2018 by default) and exports PDF, SVG and PNG. The online version reads DXF only for now. Entities it does not support yet are not kept on save, so keep a copy of your originals.
cad.faq.q4: Can I use CADCraft online without installing anything?
cad.faq.a4: Yes. Open the Use Online page and the full app loads in your browser through WebAssembly. It uses WebGPU when available and falls back to WebGL2. Chrome or Edge on a desktop computer gives the best experience.
cad.faq.q5: How do AI agents control CADCraft?
cad.faq.a5: Through an MCP server (cadcraft-cli mcp), a JSON control channel on the running app, or the headless command-line tool. Agents can run commands, query entities, inspect the drawing and render images to check their work.
cad.faq.q6: Is CADCraft ready for production work?
cad.faq.a6: It is in early, fast development. Many core drafting commands already work, but some AutoCAD features are missing (for example, SHX fonts are not read yet). Review the project's roadmap and gap list, and keep backups.
cad.faq.a7: CADCraft AI (cadcraft.org) is an independent guide to CADCraft: download and installation instructions, an online version, tutorials and a comparison with Autodesk AutoCAD. Downloads link to the official GitHub releases. Contact us at support@cadcraft.org.
cad.footer.disclaimer: CADCraft AI (cadcraft.org) is an independent community guide. It is not affiliated with Autodesk, Inc. or the ArtCraft team. AutoCAD is a registered trademark of Autodesk, Inc. CADCraft is open-source software licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.

cad.tut.lead: Basic operations for beginners and AutoCAD users. Open the online version in another tab and follow along.
cad.tut.l1_body: Almost everything in CADCraft starts at the command line. Type a command name (or its alias) and press Enter. CADCraft then prompts you for points, distances or options; keywords in the prompt can be typed directly.
cad.tut.l1_s1: Type LINE and press Enter to start the line command.
cad.tut.l1_s2: Press Enter, Space or right-click to finish. Press it again to repeat the last command.
cad.tut.l1_s3: Use AutoComplete and the command history to find commands quickly.
cad.tut.l2_body: CADCraft understands the same coordinate notation as AutoCAD, so you can place points exactly.
cad.tut.l2_s2: @dx,dy: relative to the last point, for example @10,0
cad.tut.l2_s4: #x,y: force absolute coordinates while dynamic input is on. Tip: with dynamic input on, the second point you type is relative, so use #x,y for absolute points.
cad.tut.l2_s5: Direct distance entry: point the cursor in a direction and type a distance
cad.tut.l3_body: Combine commands and coordinates to draw. The c option closes a shape back to its start point.
cad.tut.l3_s1: A closed triangle in one line:
cad.tut.l3_s2: A circle centered at 5,2 with radius 1:
cad.tut.l3_s3: Also available: PLINE, ARC, RECTANG, POLYGON, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, POINT, XLINE, RAY, DONUT, TEXT and MTEXT.
cad.tut.l4_body: Turn on drafting aids to hit exact points without typing coordinates.
cad.tut.l4_s1: Object snaps lock the cursor to endpoints, midpoints, centers and intersections.
cad.tut.l4_s2: Polar tracking and ortho constrain the cursor to set angles.
cad.tut.l4_s3: Grid snap moves the cursor in fixed steps.
cad.tut.l5_body: The modify commands work like AutoCAD: start the command, select objects, press Enter, then answer the prompts.
cad.tut.l5_s1: Offset a selected object by 0.25 units:
cad.tut.l5_s2: Use TRIM and EXTEND to clean up corners, FILLET and CHAMFER to round or bevel them.
cad.tut.l5_s3: Click an object to show its grips. Click a grip, then press Space to cycle Stretch, Move, Rotate, Scale and Mirror.
cad.tut.l5_s4: Also available: MOVE, COPY, ROTATE, SCALE, MIRROR, STRETCH, BREAK, JOIN, EXPLODE, ARRAY and OVERKILL.
cad.tut.l6_s1: Put different kinds of geometry on separate layers to control color and visibility.
cad.tut.l6_s2: Use the DIM commands for associative linear, aligned, angular and radial dimensions; MLEADER and TABLE for notes.
cad.tut.l6_s3: HATCH fills a closed area when you pick a point inside it. Islands are detected automatically.
cad.tut.l6_s4: BLOCK turns geometry into a reusable symbol; INSERT places it. Blocks support attributes and nesting.
cad.tut.l7_body: Switch to a paper-space layout to arrange floating viewports at an exact scale, set up the page, and PLOT to PDF.
cad.tut.l8_body: The desktop app opens DWG (R13-2018) and DXF (R12-2018) files and saves DXF and DWG in versions 2000 to 2018; the online version reads DXF only. Export PDF, SVG and PNG for sharing. To see the whole drawing at any time:
cad.tut.l8_note: Entities that CADCraft does not support yet are not kept when you save. Always keep a copy of important original files.
cad.tut.l9_title: 9. Automate with the CLI and MCP
cad.tut.l9_body: cadcraft-cli runs CADCraft without a window. Script a drawing, save it and render it in one command:
cad.tut.l9_s2: Let an AI agent drive CADCraft through MCP, either headless or connected to the running app (start the app with --control 7979):
cad.tut.next_desc: Read the official README and control-protocol docs on GitHub for every command and MCP tool.
cad.cmp.lead: Both use the same command-line-driven 2D drafting workflow. The difference is in price, openness, platforms and how mature each one is. Here is a fair, side-by-side look.
cad.cmp.row_price_cc: Desktop app and online editor are free; Pro hosted on this site ($4.9/month) is an optional cloud add-on
cad.cmp.row_price_ac: Subscription; about $2,000/year or $245/month list price (US, 2026; check Autodesk for current pricing)
cad.cmp.row_web_cc: Full app via WebAssembly; can be self-hosted
cad.cmp.row_2d_cc: Core commands, snaps, dimensions, hatches, blocks, layouts, constraints
cad.cmp.row_agents_cc: Native: MCP server, JSON control channel, headless CLI
cad.cmp.row_agents_ac: Autodesk AI features; automation via AutoLISP, .NET, ObjectARX
cad.cmp.adv1_desc: No license fee, no seat licenses and no account needed to draw. Install it on every machine in a classroom or office, and read or change the source code if you need to.
cad.cmp.adv2_desc: Every tool is a command with a JSON form. Agents can draw, query entities, inspect the drawing and render screenshots over MCP, with no UI scraping.
cad.cmp.adv3_desc: Native builds for Windows, macOS, Linux and FreeBSD, plus a WebAssembly version you can host on your own server or intranet.
cad.cmp.adv4_desc: Same command names, coordinate notation, snaps, grips and right-click-to-repeat. Your muscle memory still works.
cad.cmp.adv5_desc: Written in Rust with a GPU renderer (WebGPU, falling back to WebGL2 in the browser).
cad.cmp.adv6_desc: Batch-convert DWG/DXF to SVG or PNG, inspect drawings and script edits from CI pipelines with cadcraft-cli.
cad.cmp.choose_cc1: need a free 2D drafting tool for learning, hobby projects or simple drawings
cad.cmp.choose_cc2: work on Linux or want CAD in the browser without a subscription
cad.cmp.choose_cc3: want AI agents or scripts to create and check drawings
cad.cmp.choose_cc4: prefer open-source software you can audit and self-host
cad.cmp.choose_ac1: exchange DWG files daily with clients who need full fidelity
cad.cmp.choose_ac2: need 3D modeling or industry toolsets (architecture, mechanical, electrical…)
cad.cmp.choose_ac3: rely on existing AutoLISP routines, plug-ins or company standards
cad.cmp.choose_ac4: need guaranteed vendor support for production work

home.what.title: What is CADCraft?
home.what.p1: CADCraft is a free, open-source computer-aided design and drafting application. It recreates the AutoCAD-style workflow that architects, engineers, students and makers already know, as a clean-room project written from scratch in Rust. The editor is free and open source, with no license fee and no account needed to draw. This site also offers CADCraft Online Pro, an optional paid plan that adds cloud drawings, version history and share links ($4.9/month or $29/year). You can download CADCraft for Windows, macOS, Linux or FreeBSD, or run the very same app in your browser through WebAssembly.
home.what.p2: If you have used AutoCAD, CADCraft feels familiar within minutes. You type LINE, CIRCLE, OFFSET or TRIM at the command line, pick points with object snaps, use polar tracking and ortho, and repeat the last command with Enter, Space or a right-click. Drawings are organized with layers, annotated with associative dimensions, multileaders, tables and hatches, and laid out in paper space for plotting to scale.
home.what.p3: What makes CADCraft different is who else can use it. Every menu item, tool and prompt is also a command that an AI agent can call. An agent can type into the command line like a person, send structured JSON, inspect the drawing to check its own work and render an image of the result. That makes CADCraft one of the first CAD programs designed from day one for automation and AI-assisted drafting.
home.what.p4: CADCraft AI at cadcraft.org is an independent guide to the project. Here you will find a step-by-step CADCraft download guide, a hosted copy of CADCraft online, beginner tutorials and an honest comparison with AutoCAD.
home.features.title: Everything you expect from a 2D drafting tool
home.features.draw_desc: All the core drawing commands, with keyword prompts, command history, AutoComplete and aliases. Enter coordinates as x,y, @dx,dy, @distance<angle or #x,y, or simply point in a direction and type a distance.
home.artcraft.title: ArtCraft CADCraft: part of an open-source suite
home.artcraft.p1: CADCraft is developed by the ArtCraft team as one of its Crafting Apps, a family of open-source creative and technical tools rebuilt in Rust. That is why you will often see the project called ArtCraft CADCraft. The source code is public on GitHub, and every new CADCraft build is published on the project's releases page.
home.artcraft.p2: The ArtCraft Launcher installs CADCraft next to the other ArtCraft apps and keeps each one up to date. If you prefer, you can download a single CADCraft installer, a portable build or the self-hostable web version instead.
home.agents.title: The AutoCAD-style app an AI agent can actually drive
home.agents.subtitle: Every menu item, tool and prompt in CADCraft is a command. Agents type at the command line like a person, call any command with JSON, inspect the drawing and render the result.
home.agents.p2: Connect Claude or any MCP client to CADCraft and ask it to draft a plate, dimension a part or convert a folder of DWG files. Because the agent can query entities and render screenshots, it checks its own work instead of guessing.
home.compare.title: CADCraft vs AutoCAD at a glance
home.compare.subtitle: AutoCAD remains the industry standard. CADCraft is a free, open alternative for 2D drafting, automation and AI workflows. Choose CADCraft when cost, Linux support, browser access or agent automation matter most. Stay with AutoCAD when you need full DWG fidelity, 3D modeling, industry toolsets or vendor support.
home.download.title: Download CADCraft for free
home.download.subtitle: Windows users get a 64-bit MSI installer, Mac users a universal DMG for Apple silicon and Intel, and Linux users a Flatpak with AppImage, .deb and .rpm alternatives. Every official release ships SHA-256 checksums so you can verify the file.
home.learn.title: Learn CADCraft in minutes
home.learn.subtitle: Short, hands-on lessons you can follow in CADCraft online. Start with the command line, then move on to editing, export and automation.
home.faq.a8: Open the Download page and pick your platform. Windows uses an MSI installer, macOS a universal DMG and Linux a Flatpak or AppImage. You can also install CADCraft through the ArtCraft Launcher, which keeps it up to date.
home.faq.q9: What programming language is CADCraft written in?
home.faq.a9: CADCraft is written entirely in Rust. It renders on the GPU through wgpu, which uses WebGPU or WebGL2 in the browser and native graphics APIs on the desktop.
home.cta.title: Open CADCraft in your browser
home.cta.subtitle: No download and no account needed to start. Start drafting with nothing to install.

admin.analytics.title: Funnel analytics
admin.analytics.description: First-party events: unique people per step, split by source / country / build, and a daily funnel.
admin.analytics.unattributed: {orders} more orders ({revenue}) came from users with no tracked events and are not in the table.
admin.analytics.note.unique: Every step counts unique people (deduplicated by browser visitor id), not impressions; steps are counted independently.
admin.analytics.note.first_touch: First source and landing page are recorded on the visitor's first visit; country and build are from their first event in the selected range (build = git commit, + means an uncommitted local build).
admin.analytics.note.internal: Internal traffic is excluded: admin accounts, browsers that opened /admin or visited with ?internal=1, and their sign-ups and orders. Bots are never stored.
admin.analytics.note.daily: Daily table: visitors count on their first day in range; sign-ups and payments on the day they happened. A user on several devices counts once, on their earliest visitor.
admin.analytics.note.revenue: Revenue = paid orders in range (order amount ÷ 100, shown as USD). Revenue per visitor = revenue ÷ visitors — the main metric for judging changes and experiments.
